description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring low plated central body surrounded by many long plated tubular podia.
description.zh: 拟议形态研究：低矮板甲主体周围伸出多条细长板甲管足。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: A distinct construction based on low plated central body surrounded by many long plated tubular podia; not a size, color or posture variant.
distinctness.zh: 以低矮板甲主体周围伸出多条细长板甲管足建立独立几何结构，而非尺寸、配色或姿势变体。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish low plated central body surrounded by many long plated tubular podia; emphasize the largest gaps and changes in contour. Simplify fine repeated surfaces; do not copy source geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先搭建低矮板甲主体周围伸出多条细长板甲管足，突出主要间隙和轮廓变化，简化细小重复表面，不复制来源网格。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Named concept revised during taxonomic and silhouette review. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: A new ophiocistioid with soft-tissue preservation from the Silurian Herefordshire Lagerstätte
sources.supports: Sollasina plated body and numerous plated podia; fossil supports body-plan reconstruction. Eucladia woodwardi is historical assignment of Sollasina woodwardi.
